scope: Official-document research and calculations only. No live EasyEDA/API/UI, native source, PCB, schematic, library, or TEST_DAC8562 changes.

assumptions.adc_driver: OPA320AIDBVR, +3.3V/GND, unity-gain feedback before 47ohm output isolation

load_regulation_ppm_per_mA.test: VIN=VOUT+200mV; do not treat as a 60Hz/transient impedance guarantee

REF3325.settling_condition: To 0.1%, CL=1uF; actual loaded ten-channel startup not guaranteed by this typical value

OPA320.short_circuit_value_condition: VS=5.5V; not a guaranteed minimum at 3.3V or an allowed continuous operating load

dc_reference_load_calculation.tolerance_case_limit: Initial tolerance example only, not a full temperature/fault/startup bound. Future comparator/reference-divider loads are not included.
dc_reference_load_calculation.current_limit_conclusion: Ten inputs do not require a reference buffer merely to satisfy the stated DC current range.

capacitance_and_startup.network_note: Pre capacitors are behind individual 6.8k bias resistors, not ten capacitors directly on REF OUT. With grounded low-Z inputs their small-signal low-frequency extra capacitance is about Cpre/4 per channel; with open inputs it approaches Cpre behind the resistor.
capacitance_and_startup.startup_qualification: This excludes charging the direct 4.8uF and does not bound every power-sequencing case. REF33 has startup boost; test the real +3.3V ramp, all ten loads, capacitor bias derating, active negative inputs during power-off, and output settling. Do not promise 2ms maximum startup.
capacitance_and_startup.output_esr_conclusion: Latest REF33 documentation explicitly permits ceramic output capacitors; no invented minimum ESR or series resistor is justified from the reviewed text. Check effective capacitance and layout.

shared_reference_crosstalk.mechanism: Changing one input changes its current drawn from the shared reference, moving VREF through finite output impedance. Per-channel followers do not isolate this bias-current path.
shared_reference_crosstalk.low_frequency_model: For equal R, zero source resistance, N branches: deltaVREF = Zref*sum(deltaVIN)/(2R+N*Zref); a stationary driven victim sees about 0.5*deltaVREF.
shared_reference_crosstalk.qualification: These are DC load-regulation-coefficient estimates, not a guaranteed 60Hz crosstalk bound. The datasheet output-impedance graph is typical at 1uF and 0/1mA, not the present 4.8uF/3.3mA/+3.3V case. Unknown source impedance changes loading and the victim reference-transfer factor, reaching 1 for an open victim.
shared_reference_crosstalk.noise_condition: Half of REF3325 70uVpp typical 0.1-10Hz noise; common offset noise, not the complete ADC noise budget.
shared_reference_crosstalk.buffer_decision: No unconditional need from DC current alone. A low-output-impedance reference driver or separated bias domains may be justified by the specified crosstalk/error budget. Do not add one without scope/design review, stability analysis, and actual load-step/60Hz measurements.

opa320_channel_driver_checks.actual_3p3V_budget_note: Reserve supply margin plus output/ADC-transient current. Listed limits are from the stated 5.5V test; do not substitute typical graphs for a complete regulator/thermal audit.
opa320_channel_driver_checks.stability: 2.2nF exceeds the approximately 1nF pure-capacitance follower example. Existing 47ohm isolation and feedback before the resistor are essential; verify ringing, acquisition settling and actual PCB parasitics rather than claiming guaranteed stability from capacitor value alone.
opa320_channel_driver_checks.warning_against_naive_ref_buffer: Do not place an uncompensated OPA320 unity follower directly onto the existing 4.8uF reference load. Keep reference decoupling on the appropriate side and design output isolation/feedback explicitly.

unresolved_before_performance_claim: Source type/output impedance and input loading/error allowance
Required DC and 60Hz absolute accuracy, noise and interchannel crosstalk limits
Actual ADC resolution, per-channel sample rate and acquisition-time configuration
Real reference/output-driver startup, load-step, 60Hz aggressor-victim and ADC-kickback measurements
Any future open-input detector/divider loading and its separately reviewed pin contract
